TerritorySummaryOut.description:
Mobile-facing territory roll-up (Fase 2): exactly what a home screen needs.

Distinct from ``TerritoryOut`` (the plain ORM passthrough): this is a
purpose-built, computed summary so the mobile home screen needs one call,
not N. ``updated_at``/``evidence_class`` are None when the territory has no
managed assets or observations yet — never fabricated.
TerritorySummaryOut.title: TerritorySummaryOut

info.description: Decision-support system for evaluating natural tourism assets using satellite-derived environmental indicators.
info.title: SNTO — Smart Natural Tourism Observatory

get.description:
Return all alerts, optionally filtered by level.
Results are sorted by descending score (most critical first).

Flat alert listing (mobile Fase 2, ADR-014 addendum).

Mirrors ``list_managed_assets``'s own filter precedent: ``territory_id``
scopes to one territory (the join query — the actual point of this
endpoint, since no per-asset round-trip scales to "every alert a
territory has"); without it, every alert is listed, optionally narrowed
by ``status`` alone.

post.description:
Triage an alert: assign / escalate / dismiss. Dismissing requires a reason
(that is how a false positive is logged). Returns 404 if absent, 409 if the
transition is not allowed from the current status, 422 if dismissing with
no reason.

Advance a ManagedAsset along its lifecycle
(detected→verified→assigned→funded→resolved→monitored). Returns 404 if the
asset is absent, 409 if the transition is not allowed from the current
state.
Run the full SNTO pipeline for a single asset and return scored result.

get.description: Return all evaluated assets sorted by descending risk score.
